title: PJ Half Marathon 2026 Review: Petaling Jaya Single-Distance 21K

meta_description: PJ Half Marathon 2026: September 6 at Laman MBPJ, Petaling Jaya. A single-distance 21.1K in KL satellite city with registration open.
dek: Set for 6 September 2026 at Laman MBPJ in Petaling Jaya, Selangor, this is a focused single-distance half marathon with registration open.
verdict: The PJ Half Marathon is a focused single-distance 21.1K in Petaling Jaya, Kuala Lumpur largest satellite city and a major commercial hub in its own right. Anchored at Laman MBPJ the city council square, the race benefits from PJ wide roads and the city large established running community. Registration is open. A straightforward accessible Klang Valley half marathon for local runners. PJ sits directly adjacent to Kuala Lumpur with excellent highway and LRT connectivity making it one of the easiest race destinations in the Klang Valley to reach. September falls in the inter-monsoon period between the southwest and northeast monsoons with warm humid conditions and a probability of afternoon rain but manageable morning temperatures for a well-organized early start.

sections.heading: Petaling Jaya: KL Satellite City with Its Own Identity
paragraphs: Petaling Jaya commonly called PJ is the largest city in Selangor and functions as Kuala Lumpur primary satellite city though it has long since developed an identity and economy entirely its own. Originally developed as a satellite township in the 1950s to alleviate congestion in KL PJ now has a population exceeding 700000 and is a major commercial hub housing multinational offices universities and major shopping complexes like 1 Utama.

sections.heading: The Single-Distance Format
paragraphs: By offering only the 21.1K distance the PJ Half Marathon makes a deliberate choice to focus resources on a single quality route rather than diluting logistics across multiple categories. For half marathon purists this is a feature not a bug.

sections.heading: Laman MBPJ as Race Hub
paragraphs: Laman MBPJ the Petaling Jaya City Council square provides a central accessible race hub with plenty of assembly space and easy access from the Federal Highway and LDP. PJ wide arterial roads lend themselves well to a road race course.

sections.heading: September Weather in Selangor
paragraphs: September falls in the inter-monsoon period between the southwest monsoon ending in August and the northeast monsoon arriving in November. Conditions are warm and humid with afternoon thunderstorms possible but morning race conditions should be manageable.

sections.heading: Should You Run the PJ Half Marathon?
paragraphs: For Klang Valley runners this is a straightforward accessible half marathon with open registration at Laman MBPJ. The single-distance format keeps the focus on the 21.1K experience. The main caveat is limited public information about the organiser and course details. Track the RaceXAsia listing for updates.

faqs.question: When is the PJ Half Marathon 2026?
faqs.answer: The PJ Half Marathon 2026 takes place on 6 September 2026 at Laman MBPJ in Petaling Jaya Selangor Malaysia. It is a single-distance event offering only the 21.1K half marathon. Registration is currently open.

faqs.question: Why does this race only offer one distance?
faqs.answer: The PJ Half Marathon focuses exclusively on the 21.1K distance by design concentrating the organiser resources on a single quality course rather than splitting logistics across multiple categories. For half marathon runners this means a focused race-day experience.

faqs.question: Where is Laman MBPJ and how do I get there?
faqs.answer: Laman MBPJ is the Petaling Jaya City Council square located in the heart of PJ. It is easily accessible via the Federal Highway or the LDP (Lebuhraya Damansara-Puchong) and is served by the Kelana Jaya LRT line. Ample parking is available in the surrounding area.

Conditions are typically warm and humid with afternoon thunderstorms possible but morning race conditions should be manageable with temperatures in the mid-20s to low-30s Celsius.
